en: Thank you.  Check your Trainer Card.
it: Grazie.  Controlla la tua Scheda Allenatore.

en: You can record your voice later if you change your mind.
it: Puoi registrare la tua voce più tardi, se cambi idea.

en: The download failed.

en: You came from \v[1], \v[2].

en: Couldn't retrieve the location information.

en: Choose a destination.\ch[1,-1,Game Corner,Trainer area,Shadow Pokémon area,Bridges map,Water map, Harbour,Cycle Road,Cancel]

id: The $Trainer global variable contains valuable information on the player, including their trainer type, ID, name, party Pokémon, money, and so on.
en: The $Trainer global variable contains valuable information on the player, including their trainer type, ID, name, party Pokémon, money, and so on.
it: La variabile globale $Trainer contiene informazioni preziose sul giocatore, tra cui tipo di allenatore, ID, nome, Pokémon in squadra, denaro e così via.

id: Refer to PokeBattle_Trainer for details on Trainer objects.
en: Refer to PokeBattle_Trainer for details on Trainer objects.
it: Consulta PokeBattle_Trainer per i dettagli sugli oggetti Trainer.

id: The Map Connector (also known as the Visual Editor) allows you to connect maps together.
en: The Map Connector (also known as the Visual Editor) allows you to connect maps together.
it: Il Map Connector (noto anche come Visual Editor) ti permette di collegare le mappe tra loro.

id: In the Debug menu (F9 or in the pause menu), choose the "Map Connections" option.
en: In the Debug menu (F9 or in the pause menu), choose the "Map Connections" option.
it: Nel menu Debug (F9 o dal menu di pausa), scegli l'opzione "Map Connections".

id: Once there, choose a map to display by pressing the S key. Select it and press the E key to edit its encounters, or double-click it to edit its metadata.
en: Once there, choose a map to display by pressing the S key.  Select it and press the E key to edit its encounters, or double-click it to edit its metadata.
it: Una volta lì, scegli una mappa da visualizzare premendo il tasto S.  Selezionala e premi il tasto E per modificarne gli incontri, oppure fai doppio clic per modificarne i metadati.

id: Add additional maps to the canvas by pressing the A key, and drag them around to connect them. Maps only connect if just their edges touch.
en: Add additional maps to the canvas by pressing the A key, and drag them around to connect them.  Maps only connect if just their edges touch.
it: Aggiungi altre mappe all'area di lavoro premendo il tasto A, e trascinale per collegarle.  Le mappe si collegano solo se si toccano esattamente ai bordi.

id: Every tile in a tileset has a terrain tag, which is a number. This number is used to give certain tiles special effects.
en: Every tile in a tileset has a terrain tag, which is a number.  This number is used to give certain tiles special effects.
it: Ogni tile di un tileset ha un terrain tag, che è un numero.  Questo numero serve a dare effetti speciali a certi tile.

id: For example, ledge tiles have terrain tag 1, which means the player jumps over them. Ledge tiles also have a single passable direction (set separately).
en: For example, ledge tiles have terrain tag 1, which means the player jumps over them.  Ledge tiles also have a single passable direction (set separately).
it: Ad esempio, i tile delle sporgenze hanno terrain tag 1, il che significa che il giocatore ci salta sopra.  Hanno anche una sola direzione percorribile (impostata a parte).

id: Grass tiles (in which you can have wild encounters) have terrain tag 2. Water tiles have terrain tag 6 or 7.
en: Grass tiles (in which you can have wild encounters) have terrain tag 2.  Water tiles have terrain tag 6 or 7.
it: I tile dell'erba (in cui si possono incontrare Pokémon selvatici) hanno terrain tag 2.  I tile dell'acqua hanno terrain tag 6 o 7.

id: Terrain tag 0 means the tile has no special effect. See the wiki for more information and a complete list of all terrain tags and their effects.
en: Terrain tag 0 means the tile has no special effect.  See the wiki for more information and a complete list of all terrain tags and their effects.
it: Il terrain tag 0 indica che il tile non ha effetti speciali.  Consulta la wiki per maggiori informazioni e un elenco completo dei terrain tag e dei loro effetti.

id: To set a tileset's terrain tags, open the Debug menu (F9 or from the pause menu) and choose "Edit Terrain Tags".
en: To set a tileset's terrain tags, open the Debug menu (F9 or from the pause menu) and choose "Edit Terrain Tags".
it: Per impostare i terrain tag di un tileset, apri il menu Debug (F9 o dal menu di pausa) e scegli "Edit Terrain Tags".

id: \rThe "Choices" event command cannot allow more than 4 choices. This is what you should do instead.
en: \rThe "Choices" event command cannot allow more than 4 choices.  This is what you should do instead.
it: \rIl comando evento "Choices" non permette più di 4 scelte.  Ecco cosa dovresti fare invece.

id: Please choose one.\ch[1,-1, Choice 1,Choice 2,Choice 3, Choice 4,Choice 5,Choice 6]
en: Please choose one.\ch[1,-1, Choice 1,Choice 2,Choice 3, Choice 4,Choice 5,Choice 6]
it: Scegline una.\ch[1,-1, Scelta 1,Scelta 2,Scelta 3, Scelta 4,Scelta 5,Scelta 6]

id: The choice was cancelled.
en: The choice was cancelled.
it: La scelta è stata annullata.

id: Choice 1 was chosen.
en: Choice 1 was chosen.
it: È stata scelta la Scelta 1.

id: Choice 2 was chosen.
en: Choice 2 was chosen.
it: È stata scelta la Scelta 2.

id: Choice 3 was chosen.
en: Choice 3 was chosen.
it: È stata scelta la Scelta 3.

id: Choice 4 was chosen.
en: Choice 4 was chosen.
it: È stata scelta la Scelta 4.

id: Choice 5 was chosen.
en: Choice 5 was chosen.
it: È stata scelta la Scelta 5.

id: Choice 6 was chosen.
en: Choice 6 was chosen.
it: È stata scelta la Scelta 6.

id: Please choose one. This choice can't be canceled.\ch[1,0,Choice 1,Choice 2]
en: Please choose one.  This choice can't be canceled.\ch[1,0,Choice 1,Choice 2]
it: Scegline una.  Questa scelta non può essere annullata.\ch[1,0,Scelta 1,Scelta 2]

id: Multiple choice commands like these are enabled using the \\ch message command.
en: Multiple choice commands like these are enabled using the \\ch message command.
it: I comandi a scelta multipla come questi si attivano con il comando messaggio \\ch.

id: The bracketed area after \\ch consists of the Variable to store the choice, a default choice in case the player cancels, and then a number of choices.
en: The bracketed area after \\ch consists of the Variable to store the choice, a default choice in case the player cancels, and then a number of choices.
it: La parte tra parentesi dopo \\ch è composta dalla variabile in cui salvare la scelta, una scelta predefinita nel caso il giocatore annulli, e poi le varie scelte.

id: If the default choice is set to 0, the player can't cancel.
en: If the default choice is set to 0, the player can't cancel.
it: Se la scelta predefinita è impostata su 0, il giocatore non può annullare.

id: The $DEBUG flag was set. This flag is set automatically during playtesting within RMXP.
en: The $DEBUG flag was set.  This flag is set automatically during playtesting within RMXP.
it: Il flag $DEBUG è attivo.  Questo flag viene impostato automaticamente durante i test di gioco in RMXP.

id: Debug mode allows you to access the Debug menu (F9 or in the pause menu), and to modify Pokémon in your party/the PC.
en: Debug mode allows you to access the Debug menu (F9 or in the pause menu), and to modify Pokémon in your party/the PC.
it: La modalità Debug ti permette di accedere al menu Debug (F9 o dal menu di pausa) e di modificare i Pokémon nella squadra o nel PC.

id: You can also use hidden moves anytime, and hold CTRL to skip any battles and decide the outcome of Trainer battles.
en: You can also use hidden moves anytime, and hold CTRL to skip any battles and decide the outcome of Trainer battles.
it: Puoi anche usare le MN in qualsiasi momento, e tenere premuto CTRL per saltare le lotte e decidere l'esito delle lotte contro Allenatori.

id: Obtained all badges for the first and second regions.
en: Obtained all badges for the first and second regions.
it: Ottenute tutte le medaglie della prima e della seconda regione.

id: To add a badge, use $Trainer.badges[X]=true where X is a number from 0 through 7.
en: To add a badge, use $Trainer.badges[X]=true where X is a number from 0 through 7.
it: Per aggiungere una medaglia, usa $Trainer.badges[X]=true dove X è un numero da 0 a 7.

id: In Debug mode, you can set your badges in the Debug menu.
en: In Debug mode, you can set your badges in the Debug menu.
it: In modalità Debug, puoi impostare le medaglie dal menu Debug.

id: Press F8 to take a screenshot of the game.
en: Press F8 to take a screenshot of the game.
it: Premi F8 per fare uno screenshot del gioco.

id: The screenshot will be put in the folder where the save file is kept.
en: The screenshot will be put in the folder where the save file is kept.
it: Lo screenshot verrà salvato nella cartella in cui si trova il file di salvataggio.
